# Legend (use on every page and sheet)

Overlap: Same / Similar / Different / Only in one exam / Not found
App coverage: Full (15 or more questions, proposed) / Partial (1-14) / Not yet (0)
Status: VERIFIED (checked against official document) / UNVERIFIED / NON-OFFICIAL (only non-official source)
Counting method for overlap: share of an exam's syllabus topics (rows) that also appear in CTET.

Page status (pages.csv): PLANNED (no file yet) / DRAFT (being written or fact-checked) / READY (final and fact-checked, waiting to go live) / PUBLISHED (live) / RETIRED (never publish; redirect_to says where its URL should point)
Publish rule: a page goes live only when docs/tools/check_publish_ready.py says PUBLISHABLE, meaning it is READY, has no draft markers, and every page it links to is PUBLISHED or READY in the same release.
